proposals: define enum is nominal type and namespace of case values
named patterns may include enum types; enum payloads may not depend on named patterns
source newlines do not separate type unions; require |
no per-pattern return type; match<R> optional for result
Every ActorRef.send payload must be in the actor message domain AND recursively Serializable regardless of process placement
@Serializable derives codecs for eligible nominal types; mere annotation presence must never be accepted as a codec
Data-only immutable local freeze is a fast path only when a portable encoding exists; host capabilities never implicitly serialize
